title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Official Version Launches on the National Supercomputing Internet: One-Click Access, Performance Competes with the Strongest Closed-Source Models
excerpt: DeepSeek officially released the stable version of the V4-Flash model and simultaneously launched the API public test. The National Supercomputing Internet Plat
content_html:
DeepSeek officially released the stable version of the V4-Flash model and simultaneously launched the API public test. The National Supercomputing Internet Platform promptly launched the model API calling service and model file download. This officially named DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 version has undergone extensive post-training work, significantly enhancing its agent capabilities and instruction following, with multiple benchmark test results now comparable to the current strongest closed-source models.

For developers and enterprise users, the access threshold has been minimized. Users no longer need complicated environment configurations. By logging into the official website of the National Supercomputing Internet on the PC end and entering the "Model Services" section through the "Services" menu on the homepage, they can directly access the API calling page with one click. In addition to online calls, users can also download model files and complete the entire development process including fine-tuning, deployment, and adaptation optimization in a single platform using the secure and trustworthy Notebook development environment provided by the platform.

More than 1,700 models gathered, the domestic open-source ecosystem is accelerating

The significance of this launch goes beyond the opening of a single model. The National Supercomputing Internet AI community has currently accumulated more than 1,700 popular open-source large models from both domestic and international sources, covering mainstream series such as DeepSeek, GLM, Qwen, and Kimi, and has fully launched API interfaces for multiple domestic open-source large models, including DeepSeek-V4, MiniMax-M3, and Kimi-K3. This means that developers can compare, call, and switch between multiple models on the same platform, significantly reducing the trial and error costs of AI application development.

More notably, with the official operation of core nodes, the National Supercomputing Internet has become the first national-level super-intelligent integrated computing resource pool with ten thousand cards. From the underlying computing power supply to the upper-layer model services, this national platform is building a complete AI infrastructure chain. When DeepSeek's latest model can be accessed nationwide with a "one-click call," the landing speed and radiation range of domestic large models may be about to experience a brand new turning point.

content_html_zh:
DeepSeek正式发布V4-Flash模型稳定版，并同步启动API公测。 国家超算互联网平台及时推出模型API调用服务和模型文件下载。 这个正式命名为DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731的版本经过了大量的后期训练工作，显着增强了其代理能力和指令跟随能力，目前多项基准测试结果可与当前最强的闭源模型相媲美。

对于开发者和企业用户来说，接入门槛已经降到最低。 用户不再需要复杂的环境配置。 通过PC端登录国家超算互联网官网，通过首页“服务”菜单进入“模型服务”版块，可直接一键访问API调用页面。 除了在线调用外，用户还可以下载模型文件，利用平台提供的安全可信的Notebook开发环境，在单一平台中完成包括微调、部署、适配优化在内的整个开发过程。

1700余款车型齐聚，国内开源生态正在加速

此次发布的意义超出了单一车型的开放。 国家超算互联网人工智能社区目前已积累国内外热门开源大模型1700余个，涵盖DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi等主流系列，并全面推出DeepSeek-V4、MiniMax-M3、Kimi-K3等多个国产开源大模型的API接口。 这意味着开发者可以在同一平台上对多个模型进行比较、调用和切换，大幅降低AI应用开发的试错成本。

更值得注意的是，随着核心节点的正式运行，国家超算互联网成为首个国家级万卡超智能综合计算资源池。 从底层算力供应到上层模型服务，这个国家平台正在构建完整的人工智能基础设施链。 当DeepSeek的最新机型可以“一键通话”全国通达时，国产大机型的落地速度和辐射范围或许即将经历一个全新的转折点。
